sources.entry: Claude Code Handbook by nikiforovall - Collection of best practices, tips, and techniques for Claude Code development workflows, enhanced with distributable plugins

summary.name: Claude Code Handbook
summary.one_liner: A community guide by nikiforovall covering best practices, fundamentals, tips, and distributable plugins for using Claude Code in AI-assisted development.
use_cases: finding productivity shortcuts for Claude Code
reference for Claude Code development workflows
summary.what_it_does: The page is the landing page of the Claude Code Handbook, a guide organized into sections on Best Practices, Fundamentals, Tips & Tricks, and Plugins. It recommends new users read Best Practices, then Fundamentals, then Tips & Tricks. The Plugins section offers tools and agents that can be installed to extend a Claude Code workflow. It links to the official Claude Code documentation and the GitHub repository nikiforovall/claude-code-rules. The page text itself contains few concrete technical details beyond this structure.
notable: Organized learning path for new Claude Code users
Distributable plugins with tools and agents
caveats: Page text gives no detail on specific features, pricing, or supported platforms
Content is a guide and documentation index rather than a software tool itself
